meta.note: Historical odds from free public prediction markets. Real verified betting lines for CS2 are scarce without paid APIs or ToS-violating scraping. This file records what IS verifiable: Polymarket Gamma closed events and Kalshi historical settlements where available. For backtesting where no real line exists, modeled odds (VRS-gap + deterministic market inefficiency) are used and clearly labeled as MODELED — not real.
meta.limitation: No free, terms-compliant sportsbook historical odds API has been verified for TWC 2026 finalist matches. Polymarket closed qualifier markets show 0/1 resolution prices, NOT pre-match asks. Kalshi open-event discovery found 0 TWC 2026 Finals markets as of Sep 24 (see observations.json). Historical backtesting therefore uses MODELED odds with 4% overround and deterministic inefficiency based on match ID hash, labeled as such.

modeled_policy.description: VRS-gap fair probability + deterministic market inefficiency + 4% overround
modeled_policy.formula: fair_fav = min(0.85, 0.50 + 0.025 * rank_gap); fair_dog = 1 - fair_fav; market_noise = deterministic hash-based offset [-0.08, +0.08] applied to favorite fair; then market_probs = [fair+noise] * 1.04 overround; decimal_odds = 1 / market_prob
